records.source: #$b#These ores look to be of good quality... You can keep them, of course. I just wanted to see how the local geology is doing.
records.translation: #$b#這些礦石的品質看起來不錯……你當然可以留著。我只是想瞭解當地的地質狀況。

records.source: Hello! It's Robin. Could someone bring me {0} pieces of {1}? They need to be fresh... that means gathered today. Thanks!
records.translation: 大家好！我是羅賓。有人能帶{0}份{1}給我嗎？必須是新鮮的……也就是今天收集的。謝謝！

records.source: Hey, looks like you got the {0} I asked for.
records.translation: 嘿，看來你拿到我需要的{0}了。

records.source: - You can keep the ores after Clint inspects them.
records.translation: - 克林特檢查後，你可以留下礦石。
徵求：討伐{0}隻{1}的史萊姆獵人

records.source: Frost Jellies in the frozen depths of the mine.
records.translation: 礦井冰凍深處的寒霜果凍。

records.source: Red Slimes in the deep lava caverns of the local mine.
records.translation: 當地礦井熔岩洞穴深處的紅色史萊姆。

records.source: Green Slimes in the local mine.
records.translation: 當地礦井裡的綠色史萊姆。

records.source: Ah, @! So you helped us with our slime problem? Thank you!$h#$b#I hope you didn't go through too much trouble...
records.translation: 啊，@！是你幫我們解決了史萊姆問題嗎？謝謝你！$h#$b#希望沒讓你太費事……

records.source: I can remember {0} after I got {1} slime all over my brand new {2} pants... $h#$b# Well, anyways... enjoy your reward.
records.translation: 我還記得那次全新的{2}長褲沾滿{1}史萊姆泥之後，{0}……$h#$b#總之……收下你的獎勵吧。

records.source: Those slimes can be pretty dangerous in groups.#$b#It should be a little easier to go spelunking now, thanks to your efforts. Enjoy your reward!
records.translation: 那些史萊姆成群時非常危險。#$b#多虧你的努力，現在探索洞穴應該會輕鬆一點。收下獎勵吧！

records.source: The elementals are pleased with the job you did. Here's your payment, as promised.
records.translation: 元素精靈對你的工作很滿意。這是答應給你的報酬。

records.source: Wanted: Monster hunter to slay {0} {1}s in the local mines.
records.translation: 徵求：在當地礦井討伐{0}隻{1}的怪物獵人。

records.source: Ah, @! So you helped us with our monster problem? Thank you!$h#$b#I hope you didn't go through too much trouble...
records.translation: 啊，@！是你幫我們解決了怪物問題嗎？謝謝你！$h#$b#希望沒讓你太費事……

records.source: Hey! Will someone say 'Hi' to everyone in town for me? I want to spread a message of {0} today!   -Emily
records.translation: 嘿！有人能替我向鎮上每個人打聲招呼嗎？今天我想傳播{0}的訊息！   -艾米麗

records.source: - Everyone will like you a little more
records.translation: - 每個人都會更喜歡你一點

records.source: Your axe isn't strong enough to break this stump.
records.translation: 你的斧頭不夠強，無法劈開這個樹樁。
